statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
These symptoms have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was provided
The patient has diagnosis code I47.1
The patient has diagnosis code R42
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
